deal_facts.account: Party A’s exploratory interest in equity or a joint venture prompted PWRR to engage GHF and launch a broader sale process. The initial outreach produced 25 NDAs and nine IOIs, after which seven bidders advanced to diligence. New entrant Party C brought the next stage to eight participants, six of whom submitted LOIs. PWRR selected Party B and G&W; D and E briefly returned, but neither remained through the final contest, and F provided financing support rather than a new independent bid. PWRR initially prioritized Party B at $24, but G&W raised its cash offer to $25 on August 12 and Party B declined to increase. The agreement was signed August 12 and announced August 15.

test_design.unsupported_additions: Log material false additions unsupported by an expected test separately as critical errors; no denominator changes or invented negative weights. Preserve exact wrong fields and omissions even when the composite test is partial/pass.
test_design.shared_root_causes: A bad round boundary may affect placement, finality and C12 reaffirmation; a missed exit/re-entry may affect several counts; unsupported cohort identity may affect entry/exit totals. test_design.mechanics_separate: Workbook sheet/header formats, validation, note/quote lengths, required Questions, reviewer-note emptiness, word volume and checking burden are separately reported in Stage 2; no extra primary style score.
